text:
Intent UI

 
Intent UI is a chill set of React components, built on top of React Aria Components, all about keeping the web accessible. Easy to customize and just copy & paste into your React projects. Plus, it includes Tailwind CSS for sleek styling right out of the box.

 Documentation

Swing by intentui.com to peep the docs and get the lowdown on getting started!

 Agent Skills

Official component, premium design, and v3-to-v4 migration workflows are in skills/. Install them with npx skills add irsyadadl/intentui .

 Blocks & Templates

Design pages faster than ever with design..

 Sponsor

Your support helps fund ongoing development, maintenance, and new components.
I will sponsor now

 Contributing

Make sure to check out the contributing guide, and join our awesome list of contributors. We can't wait to see what you bring to the table!

 License

Licensed under the MIT license, so feel free to tweak, share, and remix as long as you give the proper shout-out!
